title: Incomplete source tree and Git metadata
problem: 162 of 207 indexed files are absent; Git refs and some objects are missing.
fix: Rebuilt the missing application as coherent FastAPI, PostgreSQL, worker and Next.js modules. Preserved original material; Git recovery is separately tracked.
verification: Real-source runtime, 29 backend checks and five browser scenarios verified.

title: Docker stack was too heavy for local operation
problem: Original startup requires numerous containers and unavailable Python dependencies.
fix: Replaced the container stack with a project venv, persistent native PostgreSQL, durable Python worker and one-command supervisor.
verification: Full stack started successfully; cooperative stop and PostgreSQL fast shutdown completed with exit code 0.

title: Elexon endpoints use different date parameter contracts
problem: A demand probe using generic from/to parameters returned a wider default window.
fix: Implemented endpoint-specific demand date parameters plus independent half-open timestamp validation.
verification: Real response contracts verified; wrong-window and timestamp validation tests pass.

title: Outdated frontend framework and broken API rewrite
problem: Next.js 15.1.0 predates security updates; proxy duplicated API version paths and assumed container localhost.
fix: Installed Next.js 16.4.6, consistent same-origin API routing, local write tokens, Origin and trusted-host checks.
verification: Production build, TypeScript, ESLint and write-auth/origin integration checks pass.

title: Forecast evaluation needs time-aware validation
problem: Single holdout selection, synthetic data and uncalibrated intervals cannot substantiate forecasting performance.
fix: Implemented publication-aware features, independent residual calibration, validation-only champion selection, held-out walk-forward testing and explicit model cards.
verification: Five comparable model candidates evaluated on 336 held-out periods. Full weather coverage; model and feature snapshots persisted.

title: Windows IPv4 and database process startup
problem: The original launcher tried localhost/IPv6 against an IPv4 listener and waited for inherited subprocess pipes.
fix: Use explicit 127.0.0.1, pg_ctl lifecycle management and child exit events; keep data persistent and use orderly shutdown.
verification: Clean single-command startup and shutdown verified against PostgreSQL 17.12.

title: Portable PostgreSQL lacks pg_dump
problem: The first backup job failed because the binary distribution omits pg_dump.
fix: Add repeatable-read logical ZIP backups containing database tables, raw archives and models, a row-count manifest, integrity checks, and guarded empty-database restore.
verification: Actual full backup created and CRC checked; disposable PostgreSQL backup/restore round trip passes, including settings and artifact preservation.

title: GB settlement dates cross UTC and daylight-saving boundaries
problem: Treating a settlement date as a fixed UTC day can discard summer intervals and distort DST days.
fix: Derive settlement request windows from Europe/London local midnight and preserve original UTC timestamps.
verification: Unit checks verify 23h spring, 25h autumn and 24h ordinary settlement days.

title: Context history was shorter than the selected range
problem: Initial ingestion bounded price and generation context to fourteen days despite a 120-day demand backfill.
fix: Backfill all selected market datasets across the requested interval, with bounded generation chunks and date-safe price requests.
verification: Full real-data job completed: 86,002 distinct observed metric/period points and 52,416 weather vintage records at verification time.

title: Charts initially rendered empty during animation
problem: Early screenshots showed an empty generation ring and partly drawn weather curves. Missing timestamps could also connect through gaps.
fix: Disable initial chart animations for reliable immediate rendering and insert explicit null chart positions for absent periods. Format axes by actual units.
verification: Desktop and mobile screenshots visually inspected; real-data browser tests pass.

title: Safe service restart and crash recovery
problem: Windows venv launchers can leave child processes alive after killing only the parent; interrupted jobs need explicit recovery.
fix: Use run-specific stop markers, cooperative Python exit, bounded child-tree cleanup, pg_ctl shutdown, a single-worker advisory lock, and interrupted-job recovery.
verification: Supervisor stop returned exit code 0; orderly API shutdown and persistent PostgreSQL shutdown verified. Stored data is retained.

title: Experiments must reproduce published predictions
problem: A model name and score alone do not reproduce a forecast.
fix: Record input-pool fingerprint, exact sample and future-feature matrices, trained artifact, versions, splits, seed and calibration details.
verification: Reloaded the trusted local artifact and feature CSV: all 48 published predictions reproduced with 0.0 MW maximum absolute difference.

title: Original Git history is incomplete
problem: The supplied .git lacks refs and some indexed objects, so normal Git operations fail.
fix: Preserve original Git metadata unchanged. Publish a fresh, allowlisted source release in the portfolio repository without reconstructing original history.
verification: Source release is independent of the damaged metadata; original-history recovery remains outstanding.

title: Live external LLM verification outstanding
problem: Optional external LLM synthesis has not been verified with a live provider request.
fix: Use deterministic evidence briefs by default. Run a live provider check only with an appropriate key and an explicitly selected evidence payload.
verification: No live provider request was performed. Deterministic reports and grounding/schema/redaction tests pass.

title: Upstream test-client deprecation warning
problem: The installed Starlette TestClient warns that its httpx compatibility path is deprecated.
fix: Runtime provider calls and tests currently work. Review a supported test-client migration before changing this dependency; do not suppress the warning.
verification: 29 backend tests pass with one recorded deprecation warning. This warning does not affect the running UI or data worker.

title: Keyboard shortcut test ran before hydration
problem: A browser test pressed Ctrl+K before client listeners were attached and intermittently missed the command dialog.
fix: Wait for the observable connected client state before exercising the shortcut. Keep both keyboard and button navigation usable.
verification: All five browser scenarios pass, including command search, chart filtering/export, evidence, settings persistence and mobile overflow.

title: Aggregate facts need all contributing source archives
problem: A mean or range computed across multiple requests cannot be attributed only to the latest request file.
fix: Record the contributing archive set and source row count alongside each aggregate evidence fact.
verification: Generated deterministic reports preserve evidence IDs, source windows, archive references and validation traces.

title: Historical weather availability is an assumption
problem: Archived forecast initialization is not a measured publication timestamp; six-city sampling is an approximation.
fix: Filter by an explicitly recorded run-plus-eight-hours assumption and actual retrieval for live composites. Preserve locally observed vintages going forward. Require complete weather coverage before adding weather candidates.
verification: Archived training coverage is 100%; model cards and research protocol state the availability and spatial-sampling limitations. No causal or profitability claim is inferred.

title: Theme preference must survive navigation
problem: A route-local theme state could disagree with the document theme after navigating between views.
fix: Use a browser-backed external theme store with a stable server snapshot, persisted preference, and storage/theme events. Link source-ledger rows to their validated raw archive endpoint.
verification: Browser test switches to light theme, navigates to another view, verifies the retained theme, then restores dark mode. All five browser scenarios pass.
